Official Binance Sep 1-28 archives; 7-day warmup, 30-second depth/trade frames, 5-minute target and 10-row split purge. Best Transformer was short-only L1 but remained 0.0179 below Logistic.
90% Logistic + 10% Transformer blend: Macro-F1 0.4574, but Logistic-dominated and standalone Transformer (0.4310) did not beat Logistic; reclassified as ensemble improvement, not an architecture win.

Enhanced section-7 architecture: dilated causal conv short encoder + medium volume bars + long 168h bars, combined via FiLM/cross-attention with short-defaulting residual gates. Best calibrated test Macro-F1 0.4339 (E2), still below Logistic 0.4476. Core deliverable latent z_t (128d) exported per timestamp and validated: linear probe test AUC 0.673/F1 0.310, KNN 0.312, cluster purity 0.837/ARI 0.075, z-norm return spread +5.0e-05. z_t contains usable but not cleanly separated directional signal.

Extended Aug8-Sep28 dataset (299,500 rows, 20,390/4,206/4,206 samples). Standalone dilated conv5 Transformer test Macro-F1 0.4201 vs same-split Logistic 0.4083 -> first clean single-model beat (+0.0118), dev-selected checkpoint. Caveats: earlier test window where both absolute F1s are lower; test AUC 0.478 (<0.5) conflicts with IC +0.025, so treat as encouraging but require rolling multi-window confirmation. Alpha traded directly from z_t remained unprofitable after costs (IC~-0.02).

Pure short dilated-conv5 Transformer test Macro-F1 0.4390 cleanly beats same-split Logistic 0.4127 (+0.0263), strengthening the E011 single-model result. Fusing the medium/long reversion-continuation priors via FiLM/residual gate made F1 worse (0.4269, -0.0121) and AUC fell to 0.400, with earlier saturation and more neutral predictions. Conclusion: keep the short event Transformer; slow reversion/continuation variables are useful for timing/filtering, not as classification features. Direct z_t trading stayed unprofitable after costs.

Added feature-axis attention (TLOB-lite) on top of conv5 + time transformer: all-prediction test Macro-F1 0.4459 (up from pure-short 0.4390), beats Logistic 0.4127 by +0.033. Slow reversion/continuation confidence filter acts only on tradability, never direction: keeping top 28% confidence lifts AUC 0.488->0.588 and IC 0.006->0.018, though subset Macro-F1 falls to 0.423 due to changed class balance. Conclusion: two-axis attention improves direction; slow filter improves actionable signal ranking and keeps capital flat 72% of the time.
